links.outcome: Expert-rated overall score comparing four LLM agents on same spinal cases
links.effect: Gemini 2.5 Flash 49.25 ± 2.88 vs DeepSeek 47.49 ± 3.34, GPT-4o 45.59 ± 3.89, GPT-4o-mini 41.23 ± 5.96 (all P < 0.001), showing substantial inter-model variability.
links.quote: Gemini 2.5 Flash achieved the highest overall score (49.25 ± 2.88), significantly outperforming DeepSeek (47.49 ± 3.34, P < 0.001), GPT-4o (45.59 ± 3.89, P < 0.001), and GPT-4o-mini (41.23 ± 5.96, P < 0.001).

unlisted_practices: Retrieval-augmented generation with domain-specific prompting, structured response formatting and evidence citation tracking for spine decision support

screen.reason: The study develops and benchmarks a domain-specific RAG-based LLM agent framework across 200 real-world retrospective spine surgery cases evaluated by five spine surgeons. While it incorporates RAG and citation tracking into the system design, it does not compare outcomes with versus without a deployment practice or safeguard, but rather benchmarks four different LLM backbones within the proposed architecture.
